messages.subject: Global Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Clark,

Ascension Global's specialist work across resources and mining leadership makes this a relevant introduction for international senior mandates.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio includes government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where resource-sector growth, regulatory execution, stakeholder confidence and responsible development must be managed together. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC, APAC and wider global mining markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
